Scoped native service factory failure against a positive owned SDK baseline in `897e2c7b572b61a6eb118104d7af739876d188b8`.

Actual PreviewsServices hostToSimConnection constructor/activate/send run with ordinary outgoing and accepted incoming anonymous XPC endpoints. Both construct32-byte wrappers/112-byte inner objects with the exact supplied raw object. Each observes one owned peer connection and one native callback PreviewsServices.XPCError/1 (connection interrupted), with zero received request dictionaries. No native request delivery is established. A bare native SDK control in the same endpoint family delivers5 independent owned bytes and a dictionary reply; same-process peer PID is checked internally, only Boolean published. An approved same-binary diagnostic reproduces failure outside the ambient sandbox; ambient permission alone does not explain that observation.

Independent cache-v5 stub/export proof binds the actual hostToSimConnection helper to xpc_connection_enable_sim2host_4sim. This simulator-specific constructor context is proven; it is NOT proven sole cause of the ordinary endpoint failure. Closed local service factories were inspected statically, without contacting hard-coded Apple production/user services. No connection flag disabled, signing policy/protection changed, Apple application re-signed, or user Xcode/simulator process touched.

640 selected instruction bytes compare independently with pinned Services cache __TEXT SHA256d52bb808c85bf5067dc936655a9dfe5ee75d54f544c1beb923195c520af9b3a3, UUIDfffb683f59433c2591b272d6e5174fa3. Qualified runtime guards require that UUID, exact symbol offsets/image paths and layouts/raw association. REA expected package/path/catalog aligned, closed/provider null. Fresh disposable replay repeats both native negative controls and positive SDK control. Native8s/compiler30s bounds,2s/3s inner waits. Owned serial-queue state snapshots; cancellation only of owned connections.

ARC/Swift bridge compile failures retained. Two exploratory seed/backend-substitution attempts SIGTRAPed with empty stderr and unlocated stage; no successful postcondition, valid ownership or causal result claimed. Failed originals/raw diagnostics local ignored; no unchanged retries planned. Sealed reproducible controls contain no field substitution. Product Rust/WASM code unchanged; prior394-test result is not claimed rerun here.

Evidence: https://github.com/aspauldingcode/xcpreviewer-rs/tree/development/research/evidence/service-connection-factory-2026-10-27 (seal `ae26f6ff4f7accd2f450116585f888587289839d1a392d1b20de51ee8294f3a3`). Original helpers/owned data/sanitized receipts only; Apple instructions/images/full exports and raw addresses/PIDs remain local. Development/master refs and preserved full-index user staging verified.

Ordinary hostToSim factory route quarantined pending suitable endpoint/context or source-qualified constructor. Earlier actual modern-updater witness success remains separate and valid. Actual daemon delivery, scene/workspace routing, application, Canvas interaction/rendering and final OS/provider settlement remain open; both milestones incomplete. Next use working caller-owned SDK carrier to correlate UVPropertyList/reconstructed request bytes while recovering a suitable local native factory contract. No essential user action is required.
